description: Designed distinctive branding assets to help startups establish a strong market presence, increasing brand recognition and user engagement. Worked on rebranding legacy brands while preserving their core image. Contracted to clients including African Conservation Foundation, Today's Budget App, Ponder, Quokkie, Tellhop, Rewilding India and Culture Booster.

Designed the brand identity for the programme and worked as a Design & Marketing Instructor. The programme, supported by Fondation de France and Migrations & Développement, teaches digital skills to rural youth.
Designed the new brand identity for the Today's Budget app.

Led and mentored a team of graphic and motion designers, improving the quality and consistency of creative output. Recruited designers, assigned tasks, reviewed work and provided regular feedback to keep projects on brief and on schedule. Created assets for an Apple Vision Pro app.
Designed the new brand identity for Tellhop.
Worked on the brand identity of Culture Booster and various other parts of its visual communication.
Designed the new brand identity for the Rewilding India organisation.
Built a personal brand and an active presence in the design community. Delivered brand identity projects for a range of clients, with a specialisation in Android adaptive and iOS app icon design.
